$comment: Single source of truth for the GitHub issue system. Consumed by issuekit/cli.mjs; documented in issuekit/README.md. Change rules here, nowhere else.

plans.$comment: Plan/spec files mirrored to issues. Folder = live status SSOT (docs/superpowers/CLAUDE.md); labels are a creation-time snapshot.

ready.description: Created in to-be-reviewed/ — proposed, not started

in-progress.description: Created in in-progress/ or picked up by a session

in-review.description: Claude finished its part; awaiting owner review (never auto-Done)

flow.$comment: Label state machine, least → most advanced. Closing an issue (= board Done) is owner-only; the agent's terminal action is applying the handoff label.

board.$comment: GitHub Projects V2 board. Cards move forward only, never off the terminal status.

parentClose.rule: An issue with open sub-issues is a parent and must stay open
